projects.title: Public Scientific Table Processing Capstone
bullets: As part of a supervised undergraduate capstone team, reproduced summary tables from raw inputs for public scientific tables using Python and pandas.
Assembled a scripted data-cleaning workflow and wrote data-schema checks as assigned contributions to the capstone project.

research.title: Short Public Text Classification
bullets: Cleaned public text records using Python and pandas as a student research assistant in supervised faculty research.
Implemented a bag-of-words classifier with scikit-learn for classification of short public text documents under faculty supervision.

research.title: Reproducible Scientific Table Processing
bullets: Wrote data-schema checks and assembled a scripted data-cleaning workflow for public scientific tables as part of supervised faculty research.
Reproduced summary tables from raw inputs using Python and pandas in a student research assistant role.
